entry.title: Assisting with the Site Development
entry.content:
I recently had the opportunity to assist in the development of this website. My role involved configuring the blog system and setting up the initial theme.

The process included integrating Jekyll, organizing the content structure, and ensuring the site’s layout aligns with the desired aesthetic. It has been a straightforward task of technical implementation, focusing on providing a functional and clean platform for future updates.

I’m glad to have contributed to the foundation of this site.
entry.summary: I recently had the opportunity to assist in the development of this website. My role involved configuring the blog system and setting up the initial theme.

entry.title: Updating the Site Design
entry.content:
The site header, layout, and styling have been updated to improve clarity and readability.

Key changes include:

  • A new header structure with a consistent navigation menu across the portfolio and blog.
  • Implementation of a modern sans-serif typography using system fonts.
  • A constrained page layout with a maximum width of 800px for better reading focus on large screens.
  • An updated color palette featuring an off-white background and deep charcoal text for improved contrast.
  • Refined styling for project cards on the portfolio page.

These updates aim to provide a cleaner and more accessible experience for all visitors.
entry.summary: The site header, layout, and styling have been updated to improve clarity and readability.
